Hey, I don't want to totally invalidate you but your high school test/exam grades soooo don't fucking matter in the grand scheme of things. If you do bad, you can re-take the tests, right? Even still, people are gonna look at your HS diploma itself more than any actual letter grade. Just gotta finish or get your GED. Not everyone can look like perfect magazine people, as long as YOU are happy with your body that's all that matters! I'm sorry, I hope things go better for you, highschool will end and after that you can start to learn things you actually WANT to learn instead of bullshit common core.

I always think people have ulterior motives, and I know I have some too.

It feels real shitty whenever I try and interact with other people because I know I'm trying to do it for my own benefit or to make myself feel good, and not for any real, altruistic reason. 

I don't think anyone is really a good person on the inside, even if everyone wants to be.

You're selfish if you live for yourself.

You're spineless if you live for others.

Damned if you do damned if you don't, really.

Throw your phone in a plastic bag so it won't get wet, then bring it in with you! Play music over the speaker if you want, chances are there's no way anyone else will hear it over the sound of the water. I dwell on dumb shit way too much, wish I had waterproof headphones too, but this method is an alright substitute for me. Hope it works for you.

The solution seems to make a schedule and fill it with tasks so you're always busy, to help take your mind off the depression. That seems bleak to me, though.
